newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash grains jump on USDA report.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash grains jump on USDA report.

text.p: Argentine cash grains jumped in cash market trading at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange on Friday's bullish U.S. Agriculture Department data, traders said.

The spot price paid to farmers for Bahia Blanca wheat rose $2 to $140. April maize leapt $4 to $96, May soybeans by $4 to $242, and March sunflower seed by $3 to $209. Traders said that the market was entirely dominated by the USDA figures, which also dragged American markets higher.
Argentine crop weather remained favorable Friday, and the wheat harvest zipped on.
